pages.title: Controls
pages.body: WASD move, mouse look, LMB attack, RMB block, Space dodge, Q parry, Tab lock-on, E interact, I inventory, Esc pause.

pages.title: Biomes
pages.body: EA includes Forgotten Castle, Crystal Caverns, Poison Swamp, Frozen Fortress, and Dark Cathedral. Select biome at the hub portal.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.body: Q: Is progress saved? A: Yes — local save syncs to cloud when logged in. Q: How do leaderboards work? A: Opt-in on escape with boss defeated.
